milestones.label: Application deadline (extended: apply to UBC and submit the award application by 2 December 2026, 12:00 noon Pacific)
milestones.source_text: UBC's International Scholars page (official) shows the final, extended deadline as 2 December 2026 at noon Pacific. Some scholarship sites still quote the earlier 15 November date.

milestones.label: Supporting documents deadline (transcripts, certificates, English test)
milestones.source_text: Official UBC page: required documents are due 31 January 2027.

milestones.label: Video interview invitations (selected applicants only; one week to complete)
milestones.source_text: UBC (official) says some applicants may be invited to a recorded video interview between January and March 2027 and get one week to complete it. An interview is not guaranteed.

milestones.label: Results released on a rolling basis; award decisions emailed early to mid April
milestones.time_text: February to April 2027 (decisions announced early to mid April 2027)
milestones.source_text: Official UBC page: results go out on a rolling basis from February to April 2027, and the award decisions are announced by email in early to mid April.
